title: AMERICAN REBEL HOLDINGS INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-09
summary: American Rebel Holdings Inc (AREB) filed Form 8-K disclosing a reverse stock split (1-for-100 on March 23, 2026) followed by issuance of 3,218,299 shares on April 6, 2026 to cure a Nasdaq listing deficiency regarding minimum publicly held shares. The company now has 3,451,665 shares outstanding and believes this resolves its non-compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(a)(4).
key_points: Company executed 1-for-100 reverse stock split on March 23, 2026.
Issued 3,218,299 shares of common stock to CEDE & Co. on April 6, 2026 for round lot share rounding.
Company previously failed to meet Nasdaq minimum 500,000 Publicly Held Shares requirement under Listing Rule 5550(a)(4).
Nasdaq had placed trading in a Qualification Halt under Listing Rule 4120(i) effective March 23, 2026.
Company believes the share issuance cures the publicly held shares deficiency.
why_it_matters: This is a microcap company (AREB) attempting to regain Nasdaq compliance after a reverse split caused it to fall below listing thresholds. The filing has no relevance to macro financial markets, monetary policy, or broad market structure. It is relevant only to investors holding or considering positions in this specific thinly-traded security.
